title: Path with Minimum Effort (Minimax Dijkstra)

monster.name: Crag Wyrm
monster.title: Navigator of Rugged Elevations
monster.defeatQuote: Route minimizing maximum single-step elevation jump found!

description: You are a hiker preparing for an upcoming hike. You are given `heights`, a 2D array of size `rows x columns`. A route's effort is the maximum absolute difference in heights between two consecutive cells of the route. Return the minimum effort required to travel from `(0, 0)` to `(rows-1, columns-1)`.
solutionCode:
def minimumEffortPath(heights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    R, C = len(heights), len(heights[0])
    import heapq
    dist = [[float('inf')] * C for _ in range(R)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    pq = [(0, 0, 0)]
    while pq:
        d, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if r == R - 1 and c == C - 1: return d
        if d > dist[r][c]: continue
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < R and 0 <= nc < C:
                effort = max(d, abs(heights[r][c] - heights[nr][nc]))
                if effort < dist[nr][nc]:
                    dist[nr][nc] = effort
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (effort, nr, nc))
    return 0
